# Sources, Licensing, and Attribution

This is a conservative content and license summary, not legal advice or trademark clearance.

## Restored project-original catalog

This edition distributes the supplied licensing-cleared Universal concordance: 34 homeworld races, 26 preserved Alien-Folk, 22 deity dossiers, 22 deity portraits, and 106 public homeworld race-deity association links.

## Rules references

The project used original teaching summaries of Daggerheart, Pathfinder Second Edition Remaster, Call of Cthulhu Seventh Edition, and Dungeons & Dragons revised fifth edition to identify usability gaps. No complete proprietary rule text, setting lore, art, trade dress, or closed character options from those games is redistributed.

## Required notices

- `CREATIVE_COMMONS_ATTRIBUTION.md`
- `OPEN_GAME_CONTENT_DECLARATION.md`
- `OPEN_GAME_LICENSE_1.0a_AND_NOTICES.txt`

## Project material

Class names, path names, Thay’lmériûn and Twenty-Two lore, Universal lore, the named race profiles, bloodlines/forms, Ichor, Thundercoils, terraforming assignments, and supplied art are treated as project source material. Confirm chain of title before commercial publication.

## Restored source files

- `Universal_Unified_Homebrew_Race_Concordance_Deity_Assigned.html`: 34 final homeworld races, 26 preserved Alien-Folk, biome profiles, bloodlines/forms, and pantheon summaries.
- `race_deity_assignments.json`: 34 homeworld race records and 106 public religious/cultural association links across all 22 deities.
- `deity_jsons/*.json`: 22 player-safe deity dossiers with public lore, worship, warnings, biomes, and associated races.
- `deities_WEBP/deities/*.webp`: 22 supplied deity portrait assets.

No missing Alien-Folk deity assignments were inferred because the supplied assignment index explicitly excludes alien races.
